draft.body:
My name is Justin Mascarenhas. I came across your profile while researching the Embedded Software Engineer role at Motorola Solutions and wanted to reach out to someone on the team.

I am finishing my MS in Computer Engineering at RIT (May 2026). My embedded background includes bare-metal device drivers (I2C, UART, ADC) on ARM Cortex-M4 (STM32), FreeRTOS mutex-coordinated task scheduling for a real-time object-tracking pipeline, and TensorRT YOLO inference at ~18 FPS deployed in C++ on NVIDIA Jetson. My B.E. is in Electronics and Telecommunication, so your mention of RTOS, UART/SPI/I2C, and Buildroot work maps closely to what I have been building.

I have applied for the role and would genuinely value any insight into the team or the interview process. I would also be grateful if you would consider a referral if my background seems like a fit.

Thank you in advance.
draft.hook_used: Engineer in same technical domain (RTOS, UART/I2C/SPI, ARM firmware) at the exact company and team being targeted
